about: The smaller notes of the 0.7 verifiers: leftover drops, stale kill-task item text, Arachneida's Prima level.

entries.sql: UPDATE ItemTemplate SET Description = replace(Description, 'Talk to Lenia Fletcher', 'Talk to Allia Fletcher') WHERE Id_nb = 'Blood_Red_Berry_Wine'
entries.why: the item still sent the player to Lenia Fletcher; kill task 109 is Allia Fletcher's since P01-E-109 (she stands beside Lenia)

entries.sql: UPDATE ItemTemplate SET Description = replace(Description, 'Minimum Level: 35 Maximum Level: 41', 'Minimum Level: 28 Maximum Level: 37') WHERE Id_nb = 'Glowing_Soul_Gem'
entries.why: the item text kept the old range; kill task 117 is 28-37 since P01-E-117

entries.sql: UPDATE ItemTemplate SET Description = replace(Description, 'Minimum Level: 31 Maximum Level: 36', 'Minimum Level: 34 Maximum Level: 40') WHERE Id_nb = 'Cultist_Staff'
entries.why: the item text kept the old range; kill task 225 is 34-40

entries.why: the item text kept the old range; kill task 242 is 41-43

entries.sql: UPDATE ItemTemplate SET Description = replace(Description, 'Chelseigh Stilman', 'Chelseigh Stillman') WHERE Id_nb = 'skin_cream'
entries.why: the item text kept the misspelt name; the Camelot merchant and kill task 169 are Chelseigh Stillman
the kill-task Unused Arrowhead has no taker since task 142 was removed (P01-E-142); quest 20699 uses cq_unused_arrowhead
the junk twin "sack of grain" stood in for the kill-task Sack of Grain that P01-A1-114 restored: two look-alike items, one accepted

entries.sql: UPDATE NpcTemplate SET Level = '12' WHERE TemplateId = 12445 AND Name = 'Arachneida'
entries.why: Prima Atlas (Campacorentin Forest loot table): "Arachneida [12]"; she was 22, purple to the level 14 the quest is for
entries.source: Dark Age of Camelot: The Atlas (Prima) "Arachneida [12] (60%) Bloated Spider Carapace"; Uthgard bestiary Campacorentin 12-13

entries.why: Arachneida's spawn row follows her template: Prima Atlas level 12
entries.source: Dark Age of Camelot: The Atlas (Prima) "Arachneida [12]"

entries.why: Rasczel's Nose had MinLevel and MaxLevel 11, as Rasczel's Bane did before P10-E4: a Berserker who reached 12 first could never get it; Prima's "11" is the start level and the other guild quests use MaxLevel 50

entries.sql: UPDATE DataQuest SET StepText = replace(StepText, ' Allakhazam spells the monster ''billious goo''; the server''s monster is ''bilious goo'' (same creature, Dales of Devwy).', '') WHERE ID = 20694
entries.why: the journal of Billious Goo Pieces showed a developer note about the monster's spelling; the step keeps 'Kill bilious goo and bring Achae Smith the Billious Goo Piece.'
